sources.snippet: DiskGenerator DiskGenerator is an automated pipeline for generating synthetic radio interferometry datasets consisting of simple disk models. It simulates realistic VLA (Very Large Array) UV coverage and mathematically models the measurement visibilities to produce ground-truth sources and their corresponding "dirty" (raw, point spread function-corrupted) images.
